title: environment-portability census of banked artifact families (leg 252's finding, generalized)
purpose: Leg 252 found one banked artifact family regenerates 202/359 leaves differently across environments with zero code change. This censuses N=10 OTHER families, enumerated in writeup/novelty/leg_287.md before any number was regenerated, to measure whether that is an outlier or the norm.

thresholds.note: fixed before the run; PORTABLE also requires zero verdict flips, zero string moves and zero structural leaf moves

read_only_guarantee.method: censused runners execute inside a throwaway copytree of the repo, so their ROOT-relative writes land in the copy

summary.primary_measurement: banked bytes vs regeneration AT THE ARTIFACT'S OWN BANKING COMMIT, so the code is byte-identical to what produced the bank and every move is attributable to the environment -- the same condition leg 252 measured under

families.why_chosen: 4 flow.newton(...) call sites -- closest structural analogue to the v11 anchor family
